title: Preimage closure at the existential hierarchy level
statement: Let $i\in\mathbb{N}$, let $L$ belong to the $i$th existential level of the polynomial hierarchy, and let $f$ be a polynomial-time computable function from binary strings to binary strings. Then $\{x:f(x)\in L\}$ belongs to the $i$th existential level of the polynomial hierarchy.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ belongs to the $i$th existential level of the polynomial hierarchy
